slides.h1: Strong 10th House. Afflicted D-10. Which One Wins?
slides.sub: A single-placement app can't even see this conflict, let alone resolve it.

slides.body: Rasi (D-1, birth chart) shows a genuinely strong 10th house — well-aspected, well-placed lord. But the Dashamsha (D-10, career divisional chart) shows real affliction on the same axis. Two real signals, pointing different ways.

points: D-1 sets the raw capacity — this doesn't get cancelled
D-10 conditions HOW that capacity expresses, not whether it exists
Amatyakaraka (career significator) placement adds a third check
Active dasha decides WHEN it's accessible

slides.body: It rarely means "no career success." It usually means: an indirect route, more friction to get credit, delays, or success in an unconventional form of the same field — not the absence of the strength the D-1 shows.

Never let one chart overrule the other. Read D-1 for capacity, D-10 for texture and timing friction, dasha for when it clears. A rule-based app checking one placement can't run this cross-check at all.
